publication.title: iPhone OS Research Atlas
publication.scope: iPhone OS 1.1.4, build 4A102; original iPod reference and native PinePhone research
publication.provenance: Original editorial synthesis of private project notebooks and experiment reports, with reviewed capture images, selected source excerpts and their provenance. Firmware, storage images, complete run artifacts and the implementation repository are not included.

record.title: Legacy SWP is exercised by userspace
record.method: Saved user exception state followed by bounded continuation
record.observation: Original userspace executed an obsolete ARM SWP instruction. The experimental compatibility path allowed the observed resident-address exchanges and subsequent startup progress.
record.limits: The exchange backend is not validated for complete atomicity, copy-on-write, permission faults, unmapped pages or multiprocessor behavior.

exhibits.title: The original UART swap receipt
exhibits.text: AppleHV SWP: result=1 pc=2fe25724 op=e1002091 addr=2fe3c788 width=4 old=0
exhibits.interpretation: result=1 records the exchange callback’s success at that observed resident address. old=0 is the value returned by the exchange. This receipt does not prove atomicity or correct fault/COW behavior.

exhibits.title: Decode the observed instruction and saved state
rows: Destination register before the undefined instruction
User ARM state in the observer capture
Word exchange; old memory value was zero
exhibits.interpretation: The register tuple comes from run 030; the success receipt comes from the separate run 031. Architecturally SWP exchanges the supplied value with memory and returns the previous word. A post-exchange register/memory dump is not included, so those final values are not presented as directly captured.

exhibits.title: Keep the two physical continuations separate
rows: Not observable after tracing was disabled
exhibits.interpretation: Reduced logging is not reduced I/O. The post-reset 1% battery reading suggests a power concern but does not establish the reset cause.
